vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 63 --species sorghum_bicolor --assembly Sorghum_bicolor_NCBIv3 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite [--tab|--vcf|--json]
fasta: the two sequences the records sit on (chromosome 9 and the unplaced scaffold super_1165) at their full length, from Sorghum_bicolor.Sorghum_bicolor_NCBIv3.dna.chromosome.9.fa and the super_1165 record of Sorghum_bicolor.Sorghum_bicolor_NCBIv3.dna.nonchromosomal.fa of Ensembl Plants release 63, every base outside the regions a run reads (each cached transcript's span with 5,000 bases of flank and each record with 2,000) masked to N; reference.fa.gz beside this file, compressed with bgzip, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form; Ensembl VEP received the decompressed file as --fasta on every run
input: variants.vcf: 293 records on chromosome 9 and the unplaced scaffold super_1165. 214 are seeded records that tools/vep-seeded-variants wrote from the converted cache and the genome sequence (generator version 1, seed 1, --records wide), their IDs naming the category and an ordinal: start and stop codons, missense and synonymous changes on each strand, splice donors and acceptors, both untranslated regions, introns, upstream, downstream and intergenic positions, frameshift insertions and deletions, in-frame deletions, and the first and last base of each sequence. 79 are known variants of the cache's variation files on chromosome 9, single-base substitutions sampled with seed 1 whose first allele is the genome's base, each under the cache's identifier, one of them multi-allelic. Twelve records name their sequence by a synonym the cache resolves: CM000768.3 and NC_012878.2 for chromosome 9 and KV917702.1 for super_1165

everything.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 63 --species sorghum_bicolor --assembly Sorghum_bicolor_NCBIv3 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --everything [--tab|--vcf|--json]

hgvs-sift.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 63 --species sorghum_bicolor --assembly Sorghum_bicolor_NCBIv3 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --hgvs --sift b [--tab|--vcf|--json]

generator: tools/vep-storable-to-json over the Ensembl Plants release 63 Sorghum_bicolor_NCBIv3 cache; tools/vep-seeded-variants --seed 1 --records wide --sequence 9 --sequence super_1165 --fasta <genome sequence> over the converted cache, and up to 300 known single-base substitutions sampled with seed 1 from the converted cache's variation files of the same sequences; Ensembl VEP over the two inputs under the default flags; tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 63 --assembly Sorghum_bicolor_NCBIv3 --species sorghum_bicolor --dataset wide=<reference>=<the seeded records> --dataset known=<reference>=<the known variants> --k 30 --seed 1 --max-span 1000000 --max-records 500 --cache <converted cache> --flank 5000 --focus-term <frameshift_variant, inframe_deletion, inframe_insertion, protein_altering_variant, start_lost, start_retained_variant, stop_lost, stop_retained_variant, stop_gained, missense_variant, synonymous_variant, incomplete_terminal_codon_variant> --focus-k 90 --include <the named records> --covers species-sorghum-ncbiv3 --covers genetic-code-tables --fasta-name reference.fa.gz; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --flank 5000 --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_function_predictions --drop-except <the transcripts on which a record changes one residue, the rows SIFT scores> --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 63 --variations <converted cache>/variations over the whole converted cache (protein features kept for the DOMAINS column of the everything set; the variation slices hold the known variants within one base of a record); scripts/fixtures/cut_plugin_regions.py --reference <genome sequence> --flank 5000 --record-flank 2000, each record named by a synonym read under the cache's name for its sequence; scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus --no-stats for the manifest's run and each flag set; tools/vep-golden-corpus flag-set (everything, hgvs-sift) and classify (the manifest's run and both flag sets, --field HGVSc --field HGVSp --field SIFT for the hgvs-sift set)

pruned_cache.variation_slices: the known variants within one base of a record under variations/9/all_vars.gz with its .csi, as the Ensembl VEP cache lays them out; super_1165, which carries no known variant, keeps an empty indexed file
